company.description: Raseedi App is the first daily fintech app for the masses. Raseedi offers underbanked users a dialer to make cheaper calls, receive saving tips, make payments and borrow Airtime and bills instantly without a credit history.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application that optimizes telecom usage by automatically selecting the cheapest SIM card for calls and tracks consumption across networks.

productsAndServices.description: An instant cash loan service integrated into the Raseedi app, offering short-term loans up to 3,000 EGP with minimal documentation and quick approval.

productsAndServices.description: A payment platform within the Raseedi app that enables users to recharge mobile credit, pay utility bills, and earn cashback points redeemable for payments.
productsAndServices.name: RaseediPay

productsAndServices.description: A feature in the Raseedi app that allows users to make free calls over WiFi or mobile data to other Raseedi members within their circle.

productsAndServices.description: A rewards system that grants users points for calls and payments, which can be used to pay for recharges and bills within the app.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $800,000, or 39.02% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,181,587 to $7,401,503, a 2.33x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 45 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 59 (+4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
